title: Theoretical insight and molecular recognition of fluconazole molecularly imprinted polymers: a combined computational and experimental analysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,19158-19175
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03211C, Paper
Open Access

Untung Gunawan, Slamet Ibrahim, Atthar Luqman Ivansyah, Sophi Damayanti
Analysis of fluconazole and 39 monomers for MIP design showed 2-acrylamido-1-ethanesulfonic acid as the optimal monomer in chloroform. QTAIM, NBO, and NCI-RDG analyses revealed the key hydrogen bond between H51 and N33 in the complex formation.
